tbesh_html:
1) a native (one rising from the soil)
1a) of man, native Israelites
1b) of tree, native (to Israel)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a spontaneous growth, i.e. native (tree or persons)
strongs_1890.derivation: from H2224 (זָרַח) (in the sense of springing up);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: bay tree, (home-) born (in the land), of the (one's own) country (nation).
